advanced-filter-description: Faka-Tonga: Advanced Filter allows to write a string containing following operators: == != <= >= && || ( ) A space is used as a separator between the Operators. You can filter for all Custom Fields by typing their names and values. For Example: Field1 == Value1. Note: If fields or values contains spaces, you need to encapsulate them into single quotes. For Example: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. For single control characters (' \/) to be skipped, you can use \. For example: Field1 == I\'m. Also you can combine multiple conditions. For Example: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Normally all operators are interpreted from left to right. You can liliu the order by placing brackets. For Example: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Also you can kumi text fields using regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

globalSearch-instructions-description: Faka-Tonga: Searches can include operators to refine the kumi.  Operators are specified by writing the operator hingoa and value separated by a colon.  For example, an operator specification of `lisi:Blocked` would limit the kumi to kaati that are contained in a lisi named *Blocked*.  If the value contains spaces or special characters it must be enclosed in quotation marks (e.g. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_board__:<title>` - kaati in palakipoe matching the specified *<title>*

globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - kaati that have a label matching *<color>* or *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-user: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_user__:<username>` - kaati where *<username>* is a *mēmipa* or *assignee*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_creator__:<username>` - kaati where *<username>* is the kaati's creator
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - kaati belonging to a palakipoe assigned to kautaha *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - kaati belonging to a palakipoe assigned to timi *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_due__:<n>` - kaati which are due up to *<n>* days from now.  `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ lisi all kaati past their due ʻaho.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_created__:<n>` - kaati which were faʻu *<n>* days ago or less
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - kaati which were modified *<n>* days ago or less
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_status__:<status>` - where *<status>* is one of the following:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: Faka-Tonga: `__predicate_all__` - all archived and unarchived kaati
globalSearch-instructions-status-ended: Faka-Tonga: `__predicate_ended__` - kaati with an end ʻaho
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: Faka-Tonga: `__predicate_public__` - kaati only in public palakipoe
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: Faka-Tonga: `__predicate_private__` - kaati only in private palakipoe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_has__:<field>` - where *<field>* is one of `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` or `__predicate_member__`.  Placing a `-` in front of *<field>* searches for the absence of a value in that field (e.g. `has:-due` searches for kaati without a due ʻaho).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - where *<sort-name>* is one of `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` or `__predicate_modified__`.  For a descending sort, place a `-` in front of the sort hingoa.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: Faka-Tonga: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - where *<n>* is a positive integer expressing the number of kaati to be displayed per page.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Faka-Tonga: Multiple operators may be specified.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:

cards-loading-description: Faka-Tonga: WeKan loads palakipoe kaati automatically: a big palakipoe (over the size threshold) loads only the kaati currently visible (infinite scroll) plus a live count, so it stays fast and uses less memory and bandwidth, while smaller palakipoe load every kaati for the simplest, fully featured experience. There is nothing to configure. Operators can still force a mode with the CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) and CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD environment variables.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Faka-Tonga: Lazy kaati loading is experimental: kaati counters and WIP limits are accurate, but the Calendar/Table/Gantt views and multi-select reflect only the kaati loaded so far. Reload fakaava palakipoe after changing this.
render-links-as-plain-text: Faka-Tonga: Render links as plain text
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Faka-Tonga: When enabled, all links (both markdown links like [label](url) and raw HTML <a href> tags) are always shown as plain, non-clickable text in every rich text field (palakipoe and kaati titles, descriptions, fakamatala, checklists, etc.). This prevents misleading clickable links. Default is off, so links stay clickable.
always-show-code-as-text: Faka-Tonga: Always show all code as plain text
always-show-code-as-text-description: Faka-Tonga: When enabled, rich text is never rendered as markdown or HTML: the entire source is always shown as plain text in every rich text field (palakipoe and kaati titles, descriptions, fakamatala, checklists, etc.). This reveals hidden content — HTML fakamatala (<!-- -->), the target of markdown links, JavaScript and any other code — so all code is always visible, not clickable, and not running. Default is off, so markdown is rendered normally.
disable-all-import-description: Faka-Tonga: When enabled, all import features are turned off: importing a palakipoe from WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo, as well as cloning a palakipoe. The import menu options are hidden and the server rejects any import request. Default is off.
disable-all-export-description: Faka-Tonga: When enabled, all export features are turned off: exporting a palakipoe as WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, or to NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, and single-fakapipiki export. The export menu options are hidden and the server rejects any export request. Default is off.
disable-import-avatars-description: Faka-Tonga: When enabled, avatars (tokotaha ngāue profile pictures) are never imported. This covers WeKan JSON import, Trello import, and avatar sync from external identity providers on login (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Names and other data are still imported; only avatars are skipped. Default is off.
disable-export-avatars-description: Faka-Tonga: When enabled, avatars (tokotaha ngāue profile pictures) are never included when exporting a palakipoe (WeKan JSON and CSV export). Usernames and other data are still exported; only avatars are omitted. Default is off.
anonymize-import-users-description: Faka-Tonga: When enabled, importing a WeKan JSON palakipoe replaces every imported tokotaha ngāue's username, full hingoa and initials with counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, and rewrites @username mentions (and the requested-by / assigned-by fields) inside imported kaati and fakamatala content. No real tokotaha ngāue identity from the source palakipoe is stored. The word "tokotaha ngāue" follows the language of the person importing. Default is off.
anonymize-export-users-description: Faka-Tonga: When enabled, exporting a palakipoe replaces every exported tokotaha ngāue's username, full hingoa and initials with counter placeholders (user1, user2, ...), drops their avatar, and rewrites @username mentions (and the requested-by / assigned-by fields) inside kaati and fakamatala content. The exported faile carries no real tokotaha ngāue identity. The word "tokotaha ngāue" follows the language of the person exporting. Default is off.
disable-activities-description: Faka-Tonga: When enabled, ngāue-feed entries are never recorded and never shown anywhere (palakipoe sidebar and kaati ngāue tab). No history of who did what is kept. Default is off.
disable-notifications-description: Faka-Tonga: When enabled, WeKan never sends watch fanongonongo (in-app, ʻīmeili or other services) for any ngāue. Activities can still be recorded (unless also disabled above); only the fanongonongo are suppressed. Default is off.
disable-watch-description: Faka-Tonga: When enabled, the watch feature is turned off — tokotaha ngāue cannot subscribe to palakipoe, lisi or kaati to receive fanongonongo, and any attempt to liliu a watch level is rejected. Default is off.
backup-description: Faka-Tonga: Back up fakapipiki, Avatars and/or Data (all text-based collections that are not fakapipiki or avatars). The .zip is streamed directly to the selected storage — no temporary faile — as backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, containing YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/fakapipiki, /avatars and /data. Cloud storages (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) use the credentials configured in their storage tabs.
backup-scope-description: Faka-Tonga: The whole instance, or one kautaha. An kautaha's backup contains its palakipoe and everything on them, including the fakapipiki of those palakipoe — but no tokotaha ngāue accounts and no instance ngaahi fokotuʻutuʻu, because those are shared by every kautaha. Restoring an kautaha's backup only ever writes to palakipoe that kautaha owns.
